notes: Scope: JOURNEY/CRM/SALES/SUPPORT/OPS/PROJECT/SITES/CONTROL_ROOM/MOVEMENT. Verified in code at main 6f63aaa (read-only). New findings beyond the brief's known facts: (1) POST /api/site00/client-production action=activate-project lets ANY authenticated user create a project with payment_state CONFIRMED (clientStudio.ts:553-612), a client-ready blocker. (2) ensureDemoProjectSeeded/ensureAdminOpsSeeded run on ~10+ production admin read paths and auto-insert NORTHQUARTER demo identity/lead/booking/site/invoices; convertIntakeToProject also seeds and falls back to client@northquarter.example. (3) sendEmailAsync never calls a provider even when EMAIL_PROVIDER is set (it only marks 'queued' in an in-memory log). (4) Leads, discovery bookings, invoices, sites, identities and client_feedback have NO non-seed writers. The CRM tables are real, but only demo data ever reaches them. (5) The founder world-intake invite (site00_intake_invites) is the only working token-invite pattern and should be reused for project membership. Client-ready blocker chain for one paying client: server role authority → client fetch Bearer → send-to-client → return loop → onboarding link → unpaid-activation gate → demo/fixture isolation (CTRL ROOM, sites, inbox) → launch handoff + site row → password reset route. Payment, messaging, membership, notifications, and email are POST_FIRST_CLIENT (they can be handled manually or off-platform for client 1). Lower-confidence items come from prior lead docs (entry_exit/nav/control/workspace) and were spot-checked rather than fully re-traced.
